map.输入商品利润、物流成本与当前购物车金额，计算最优包邮门槛与凑单建议，在提升客单价: Enter item profit, logistics cost and the current cart amount to compute the optimal free shipping threshold and top-up suggestion, raising order value while controlling free shipping cost.
map.设满 99 包邮，算当前购物车还差多少达标。: Set free shipping at 99 and work out how much the current cart still needs.
map.评估「让利凑单」的商家成本是否低于运费。: Assess whether the merchant's cost of "discounting to reach the threshold" is below the shipping fee.
map.做凑单提示文案提升客单价。: Write copy that nudges customers to add items and raise the order value.
map.：包邮门槛 99、当前购物车 80、毛利率 40%、运费 10 元 → 需凑 1: : free shipping threshold 99, current cart 80, gross margin 40%, shipping 10 CNY -> 19 CNY more needed; merchant cost = 19 x (1 - 40%) = 11.4 CNY, above the 10 CNY shipping fee, so assess whether it is worth it or adjust the threshold.
map.：若毛利率 60%，凑 19 元成本=19×0.4=7.6 元 < 运费 10: : with a 60% gross margin, the cost of a 19 CNY top-up = 19 x 0.4 = 7.6 CNY, below the 10 CNY shipping fee, so nudging the customer to top up saves shipping and the merchant still profits.
map.凑单成本怎么估？: How to estimate the cost of top-up items?
map.用「差额×(1−毛利率)」估商家货成本，与运费比：成本低于运费时鼓励凑单双方都划: Estimate the merchant's cost of goods as "shortfall x (1 - gross margin)" and compare with shipping: when the cost is below shipping, nudging a top-up benefits both sides.
map.参考客单价分布，门槛略低于平均客单价最能拉动凑单而不流失。: Look at the distribution of average order values; setting the threshold slightly below the average order value best drives top-ups without losing customers.
